question: Meili brought as many as four Sandworms to the Royal Capital, but if she really put her mind to it, would she be able to freely cause things like ground subsidence or destroy the sewer system?
answer:
Of course, it depends on her knowledge as well, but it is possible to use large mabeasts to cause major damage. It is possible, and in fact, I imagine that's the sort of thing she has actually done in the past. She could do enough to devastate a large city.

That said, if you ask whether she could actually do that in the Royal Capital, Reinhard is there, so she would be stopped beforehand. There are other strong people in the Royal Capital too, such as Marcos-san, so if you're asking whether Meili alone could carry out something resembling an act of terrorism on a scale large enough to cause catastrophic damage to the Royal Capital, I don't think she could go quite that far.

Meili has a pretty messed-up past, so if you wanted to get her thinking up bad things to do, she could come up with all sorts of them. So it's a good thing that she's been separated from Capella for now.

If Capella and Meili had remained together all the way into Arc 10, that would have been pretty dangerous, wouldn't it? It's like, “What the hell would Capella make her do...?” (laughs)
